args.title: Make error toasts assertive and not auto-dismissed
args.body:
File: src/components/Toast.tsx

Change the error toasts live region from polite to assertive for immediate screen reader announcement and prevent automatic dismissal so they stay visible until manually dismissed.

file: src/components/Toast.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The file src/components/Toast.tsx manages error toasts and their aria-live regions. The change is needed there to make the error toasts assertive for immediate announcements and to stop them from automatically dismissing, so users can manually dismiss them instead.
